message: Structure ((nilimpa-nirjharī)-(nikuñja-koṭara)) contradicts the vigraha and meaning, which group left to right: [[river of the gods]'s bower]'s hollow.
iti marks śiva as the quoted content of the mantra, but p12 (nipāta) has head null, leaving the quotation unattached to mantram (p13).
Calls shlokam's phāla 'a spelling difference' for bhāla; no excerpt supports that (no MW phāla entry, shlokam glosses lalāma as forehead). Same claim in words.w10.notes.
suggested_fix: 'shlokam.org writes phāla where the others have bhāla, apparently a variant spelling of the same word' (and in w10.notes).
